bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, MACD crossed up, on $54.6
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 超卖，MACD 上穿，位于 $54.6

read.en: Intel fell 0.9% on Nov 18 to $54.67, trading $53.44–56.00 on light volume (0.55x the 20-day average). It is below the falling 5-day ($57.2), 10-day ($57.5), 30-day ($78.0) and 100-day ($95.9) and the rising 200-day ($87.5). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 18, still well below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($69.73), and RSI is 29.4, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月18日下跌 0.9%，收于 $54.67，盘中区间 $53.44–56.00，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.55 倍）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$57.2）、10 日（$57.5）、30 日（$78.0）和 100 日均线（$95.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$87.5）下方。MACD 于 11月18日上穿信号线，仍远在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$69.73），RSI 为 29.4，处于超卖。

read.en: The close slipped under the Nov 16 low ($54.89) but held the Nov 6 low ($54.56), and the $53.44 low stayed above $52.25–52.4. Resistance is $54.9–56, then $56.8–57.5 (Nov 4 and 10 lows, 5- and 10-day) and $59.4–60.6. Support is $54.56, then $52.25–53.4 (Nov 5 close, Nov 17 and 18 lows) and $51.5 (Nov 5 low). A close above $57.5 would target $59.4; below $52.25, $51.5.
